verdict.rationale: Render documents ephemeral preview environments for every change, but nothing in the evidence shows a way for teammates or collaborators to comment directly on preview or production deployments. Preview environments are a related feature, not the commenting capability itself. Collaboration feedback is a fair axis for a cloud deployment platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let teammates and collaborators comment directly on preview and production environments
